Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2021-21974 heap overflow vulnerability in OpenSLP service on VMware ESXi servers to deploy ransomware
Encrypts ESXi virtual machine files (.vmx, .vmdk, .vmxf, .vmsd, .nvram, etc.) using RSA-2048 and Sosemanuk stream cipher
Terminates running VMs forcibly, modifies VM configuration files, deletes logs and backdoors
Replaces ESXi home page and motd with ransom notes
Encryptor based on leaked Babuk source code with modifications
Impacted Systems: VMware ESXi hypervisors versions 6.x and prior to 6.7
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via unauthenticated heap overflow in OpenSLP service (port 427)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named ransom.html, How to Restore Your Files.html, motd file replaced
Existence of vmtools.py backdoor file in /store/packages/
Encrypted files with extensions .vmxf, .vmx, .vmdk, .vmsd, .nvram and associated .args files
Modified VMX files with '.vmdk' and '.vswp' strings changed to '1.vmdk' and '1.vswp'
Deleted or modified cron jobs and configuration files: /var/spool/cron/crontabs/root, /bin/hostd-probe.sh, /etc/vmware/rhttpproxy/endpoints.conf, /etc/rc.local.d/local.sh
